paper_trading.comment: 2-4 week validation period with simulated execution

risk_controls.comment: Stops trading after -2% daily loss, limits position to $500

execution_assumptions.comment: Gold typically trades with $0.50-1.00 spread; add slippage

data_sources.comment: Will use most recent XAUUSD prices from IBKR

monitoring.comment: Logs daily, checks for new prices every minute

pre_start: Verify IBKR price cache is recent (< 24 hours old)
Review risk limits (2% daily stop, $500 max position)
Check log directory exists and is writable
during_trading: Review each trade for realistic execution
Check slippage assumptions vs actual market
Verify no position exceeds risk limits
Ensure strategy is trading (not just logging)
post_completion: Compare paper trading results vs backtest
Review win rate and average trade size
Assess max drawdown vs acceptable risk
Decide: proceed to small live trading or refine strategy

success_criteria.comment: If all criteria met, strategy ready for small live test
